# TaskDone

`schemas/records/task-done.json`

The payload of task.done/v1 (M1 slice plan §1 admission; D51; I22): an admitted task ended, terminally: as a candidate (M1(a)'s template variant: its review's go selected, merge inactive), or abandoned, its approval no longer in force (reason authority_revoked; #226 entry 100). It frees admission: the next task is admitted only once the admitted one is done. internal/authority admits it only under its task's id and project, by a live system actor at its event's time, of the admitted task: a candidate with none of its current nodes claimed or held; an abandonment with its approval not in force and no live lease on any of its nodes.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | yes | [TaskID](common-defs.md#taskid) |  |
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `as` | yes | one of `candidate`, `abandoned` | What the task ended as: candidate, the end of M1(a)'s template; or abandoned, with no candidate. |
| `reason` | yes | null or one of `authority_revoked` | Why an abandoned task ended (authority_revoked: its approval is no longer in force); null for a candidate. |
| `at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
